# Papierwerk outward border

- Source: https://github.com/gentrax/papierwerk-editor
- Pinned commit: `4ec40a640dec268d2cdf34a77b1d8d2983377bbd`
- `index.html` Git blob: `6f21a0202bc4e5819a605d10d867c541c92f3e1b`
- Copyright (c) 2026 gentrax; MIT. Original LICENSE is included unchanged.
- `border-source.txt` preserves the relevant public source lines 770–802, 829–848,
  936–1031, rather than the unrelated editor, fonts or animations.

`crates/render/src/torn_paper.rs` ports mulberry32, three-octave mean-centered noise,
the exact separable Euclidean distance transform and addTornBorder's threshold,
3-pixel jagged sampling, 1.3-pixel coverage edge and textured paper composite.
It adds paper **behind** the source. Opaque original pixels are never altered.

Host adaptations: the effect works in premultiplied RGBA, supports paper color alpha,
anchors noise to node coordinates rather than a clipped viewport and expands native
render/export bounds. Large border noise maps are sampled at at most 2048 pixels on
their longest side and cached per thread; original source pixels and resolution are
unaffected. Fully translucent artwork falls back to half its maximum alpha for the
silhouette seed when the upstream threshold 110 would find no seeds. Colors above
one after the upstream texture modulation are clamped to valid premultiplied bytes.
The native renderer's existing raster and memory limits still apply.

Reference regression samples are generated by executing the pinned upstream source
excerpt on synthetic RGBA data. No third-party images, fonts or editor UI are shipped.
